answer: A haven of honest peers vouches for newcomers, while the canyon between verified and unverified tiers keeps cheap fakes out, and the atlas of stake history makes duplicate identities costly to sustain, since attackers must burn real capital per clone. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified off-chain credential, and every epoch a random subset is challenged to prove liveness. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
